name: cluster-offload
author: OmniCortex
description: Where should this run? Free GPU memory on this computer and every connected host, read from Studio's system monitor and (optionally) a Proxmox cluster's API; a placement plan for a model of a given size: one machine when it fits, otherwise a layer split across machines (llama.cpp RPC) with the RPC servers and tensor split to set.

jobs.title: Cluster: where does this model fit?
jobs.help: Reads live GPU memory from Studio (this computer and connected hosts) and places a model of the given size: the device with the most free memory if one fits it, otherwise the fewest devices that together do, as RPC servers and a tensor split for the model's settings.

fields.name: ctx_gb
fields.help: room for the KV cache and buffers

fields.name: headroom
fields.help: use at most this share of free memory

fields.name: proxmox
fields.help: a Proxmox report JSON (the other job) to include its GPUs

jobs.title: Cluster: read a Proxmox cluster
jobs.help: Nodes, their memory and CPU, guests (VMs and LXC containers) and the GPUs each node has, from the Proxmox VE API with an API token (Datacenter → Permissions → API Tokens; PVEAuditor is enough). GPUs given to LXC containers can be shared; a GPU passed through to a VM belongs to that VM.
